# Fishing (skill)

Effect: +2% reeling speed, -0.8%, stamina, usage per level | Description: Stamina drain and pull speed when fishing.

# Introduction

Fishing is a player skill related to Fishing.

## Effects

Higher skill level in fishing increases the reeling speed by up to +200% (2% per level) and reduces the stamina usage down to -80% (-0.8% per level).

## Leveling up

The player gains 0.25 xp per second while reeling an empty line. This increases to 0.5 xp per second when a fish is hooked.

Categorias: Skills, Fishing
